meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord, Mr Alvarez, about the broken heating in apartment 4B and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes. To: landlord@example.com; Subject: Heating not working in apartment 4B; the body starts "Dear Mr. Alvarez," and is signed Alex. A tone switch between Polite and Firm rewrites the body: the Polite one asks "Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?", the Firm one says "Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out." Send and Discard buttons; Send needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows "Sent to" the address with the subject and the body as it was sent.
meta.text:
The errors came from my previous answer: I wrote the tone-dependent body text inline in the `->` actions and forgot `=` on the Body field. Here is the whole UI again, with the body text kept in a single variable and the tone switch setting it through a plain formula.

state tone="Polite"
state to="landlord@example.com"
state subject="Heating not working in apartment 4B"
state sent=false
state polite="Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?\n\nThank you,\nAlex"
state firm="Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out.\n\nThank you,\nAlex"
state body=polite

ChatCard "Email to landlord" "Draft, editable before sending" icon:"mail" status:=sent?"Sent":"Draft" tone:=sent?"good":"accent" {"w": 390}
  if !sent
    SectionLabel "Tone" "rewrites the body"
    Segments =tone options:["Polite","Firm"] -> body=result=="Polite"?polite:firm
    SectionLabel "To" ""
    InputField "Recipient" "name@example.com" =to
    SectionLabel "Subject" ""
    InputField "Subject" "" =subject
    SectionLabel "Body" ""
    InputField "Message" "" =body lines:8
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Discard" quiet icon:"delete" -> to="";subject="";body=""
      ActionButton "Send" primary icon:"send" enabled:=to!=""&&subject!="" -> sent=true; emit send
  if sent
    Receipt "Sent to" "landlord@example.com" tone:"good" icon:"check"
    Details rows:=[["Subject",subject],["Body",body]]
